annotations.title: Change rankings, matches, draws and trades

description: Declares game features: score boards (neblla.scores, ELO too), matches from rooms, fair draws (card packs, loot boxes) and trades between users. scores replaces all boards: one left out is deleted with its scores (scoreRenames keeps them). Reading and correcting: neblla_scores, neblla_matches, neblla_draws, neblla_trades. Waits in the draft until neblla_promote "save" (env "pro" for the users).

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

env.description: "pro" (the published app, what users have) or "pre" (the private test copy); left out: the environment the developer picked for this app in the panel.

matches.description: Rooms' games as matches with results (a duel, a 2v2); see the guide section.

scoreRenames.description: With scores: { oldName: newName } for boards renamed in this call, keeping their scores.

scores.description: Replaces all boards: { <board>: { … } }; null removes them.

trade.description: What users may trade with neblla.db.offer; null turns trading off.

name: neblla_update_app_games
